syn: bow shackle safety bolt and fixed nut
name: Green Pin Bow Shackle FN
desc: The Green Pin® Bow Shackle FN is a standard bow shackle with a safety bolt and fixed nut, featuring a bow and pin made of grade 6 high-tensile steel that is quenched and tempered. It has a safety factor where MBL equals 6 x WLL and complies with the EN 13889 standard while meeting the performance requirements of US Fed. Spec. RR-C-271 Type IVA Class 3, grade A, with shackles from 2 t and upward, also complying with ASME B30.26. Additionally, the product features a hot-dip galvanized finish, operates within a temperature range of -40°C up to +200°C, and carries certifications including 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, MTC, DNV GL 2.7-1, and CE.
